# Bhartiya IP Solutions

> Bhartiya IP Solutions provides Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) registration and facilitation
> services in India: Trademark, Copyright, and Patent registration, plus Privacy Policy drafting.
> We guide founders, creators, and inventors through government filing processes in plain language,
> including objection replies, show cause hearings, and opposition defence.

Registration outcomes depend on the relevant Indian government authority (IP India, the Copyright
Office, or the Patent Office) and are never guaranteed. Government fees and statutory timelines
referenced across this site are indicative and subject to change.

## Core Services

- [Trademark Registration](https://www.bhartiyaipsolutions.com/services/trademark): brand names, logos, and slogans — search, filing, examination, objection, opposition, renewal.
- [Copyright Registration](https://www.bhartiyaipsolutions.com/services/copyright): literary (incl. software), dramatic, musical, artistic, film, and sound recording works.
- [Patent Registration](https://www.bhartiyaipsolutions.com/services/patent): provisional, complete, and PCT/international patent applications.
- [Privacy Policy Drafting](https://www.bhartiyaipsolutions.com/services/privacy-policy): privacy policy documents for websites and apps.
